Thailand Travel Guide: destinations, monsoon notes, and how to get there

Start with Bangkok, then pick a north or south fork. The monsoon flips: Andaman is easier November to April, the Gulf is easier January to September.

First weekBangkok plus Chiang Mai or one island group

This site is for Western first-time planners who still want hyper-local utility: which BTS gate, which pier, which soi after dark.

Use the 7-day and 14-day itineraries as a spine. Swap the south coast when the monsoon says so. Book stays and airport cars on Trip.com. Book island boats and attraction tickets on Klook.

Common questions

How many days do you need?
Seven days covers Bangkok plus one more city. Fourteen days covers Bangkok, the north, and one south coast. Do not stack Phuket and Samui on a first week.
Which airport for Bangkok?
Suvarnabhumi (BKK) handles most long-haul flights. Don Mueang (DMK) is the low-cost hub. Both have Trip.com airport cars and a rail link into town.
